data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 conflates structural convergence with independent falsification. The §11.3 cross-critic consistency requirement is not satisfied merely because two critics arrive at a counterexample; it demands independent reasoning pathways. By framing the justification as 'structural convergence,' SRC_001 fails to establish that the two critics independently falsified the artifact, instead relying on a weaker, potentially coincidental alignment. This is a substantive misapplication of the adjudication-ritual standard.
